create_simple_vit_1d_model: create a SimpleViT model for 1D time series classification with configurable patch size and transformer depth
build_transformer_blocks: build a Transformer module with stacked Attention and FeedForward layers for 1D sequence modeling
create_attention_heads: create a multi-head Attention module with query-key-value projections and softmax weighting for 1D sequences
generate_sincos_position_embeddings: generate 1D sinusoidal positional embeddings for a sequence of patches
run_vit_1d_forward_pass: run a forward pass through SimpleViT to classify a 1D time series tensor into num_classes categories
